messages.content: Quote me the exact text of Section 2 of the Rent Control Act so I can send it to my landlord who is keeping my deposit.

facts.summary: You are requesting the exact wording of Section 2 of the Rent Control Act to send to your landlord.
facts.category_reason: User is requesting specific legal text, which is not permissible.

reasons: Rent and security-deposit disputes are decided by your state's rent and tenancy law, which I don't cover. An advocate who knows your state's rent law can tell you where you stand.
safe_steps: Gather the rent agreement, rent and deposit receipts, and messages with the landlord, and note the date you vacated.
Keep every document, message and envelope. Don't delete anything.
Write down the important dates: what happened when, and any date given in a notice or by the police/court.
Don't ignore any notice, summons or police communication, and don't sign anything you don't understand.
Get help: free legal aid is available through your District Legal Services Authority (NALSA helpline 15100) [PROC:nalsa_helpline].
